name: Straubing (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Straubing (a red wheel and a ploughshare on white with lozenges and a fleur-de-lis).
history: Municipal flag of Straubing; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
